text:
[issue by Trinsdar]
### Suggestion

I was looking into modifying Fluid Tooltips in jei, but unfortunately on 1.20.1 it looks like there isn't any way to do it since forge doesn't have the FluidTooltipEvent that neoforge has. Currently I would have to mixin into FouidTankRenderer to modify the tooltips, and i would rather not have to do that .
Edit: i did just check, apparently even as of mc 26.3 there is no FluidTooltipEvent in forge, though I'm going to use neoforge, not forge, in 1.21+, so that's not important to me.

[comment by mezz (owner)]
Thanks for the suggestion!
Could you please suggest this to Forge for 1.20.1? That would be the cleanest place for this.
If they reject the idea, maybe I can try to figure something out in JEI.

[comment by Fealtous (none)]
Basically just forwarding my response to the subsequent question on discord:

Doesn't seem like a breaking change to add so I don't see any problems with it, though Lex will correct me if I'm wrong.
